title: carduus × estivali subsp. carbonelii
intro: Carduus × estivali subsp. carbonelii, commonly known as a subspecies of thistle, is a plant that belongs to the genus Carduus and is primarily found in the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Carduus × estivali subsp. carbonelii include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestive health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Carduus × estivali subsp. carbonelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
